faq.label: Support
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your devotional journey.

q1.question: How do I access the Tea With God app?
q1.answer: After purchasing, you'll receive an access code via email. Enter this code in the app to unlock your full 40-day journey. The app works on Android, iOS, and web browsers.

q2.question: What's included in each access tier?
q2.answer:
Book Access (R99): All 40 devotionals in eBook format.

Journey Access (R149): Full app access with devotionals, private journal, and progress tracking.

Premium Access (R249): Everything in Journey plus voice recordings, crisis support prayers, and all future updates.

q3.question: Can I use the app offline?
q3.answer: Yes! Once you've accessed the app with your code, all 40 devotionals are stored on your device. You can use the app anywhere, anytime - no internet required.

q1.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q1.answer: We accept card payments (Visa, Mastercard) through Yoco, as well as EFT bank transfers. Card payments provide instant access, while EFT orders are verified within 24 hours.

q2.question: How long does it take to receive my access code?
q2.answer:
Card payments: Instant - your access code is sent immediately after payment.

EFT payments: Within 24 hours of payment verification. You'll receive an email with your code once confirmed.

q3.question: Can I share my access code?
q3.answer: Access codes are for individual use. If you'd like to gift Tea With God to someone, you can purchase additional codes. For churches or organizations needing multiple licenses, please visit our B2B portal.

q1.question: Is my journal private?
q1.answer: Absolutely. Your journal entries are stored only on your device and are encrypted. We cannot read your entries - they never leave your phone. Your devotional journey is completely private.

q2.question: What happens to my data if I delete the app?
q2.answer: Since your journal and progress are stored locally, deleting the app will remove this data from your device. Your access code remains valid, so you can reinstall and start fresh. We recommend exporting any journal entries you want to keep before uninstalling.

q1.question: Do I have to complete a day before moving on?
q1.answer: No pressure, no demands. While the journey is designed to be experienced one day at a time, you can move at your own pace. Some days you might need to sit longer. Other days you might move forward. This is your journey.

q2.question: What are the "brain games"?
q2.answer: These are gentle, evidence-based exercises designed to support your journey. They include breathing exercises, gratitude practices, thought reframing, and scripture memory tools - all grounded in psychology and faith.

q3.question: Is this a replacement for therapy?
q3.answer: Tea With God is a devotional companion, not a substitute for professional mental health care. If you're struggling with serious mental health issues, please seek help from a qualified therapist or counselor. This app is designed to complement, not replace, professional support.

science.label: Evidence-Based Growth
science.title: The Science Behind Your Journey
science.subtitle: Tea With God combines ancient spiritual wisdom with modern neuroscience. Here's why it works.

intro.p1: Our brain games aren't random feel-good exercises. They're carefully designed interventions based on peer-reviewed research in neuroscience, psychology, and trauma recovery.
intro.p2: Each game targets specific brain regions and psychological mechanisms to support genuine, lasting growth.

principles.title: Evidence-Based Brain Health Principles
principles.intro: Modern brain imaging research has identified foundational principles for brain health. These evidence-based insights inform our entire approach:

1.title: Brain in Everything
1.description: Your brain is involved in everything you do - how you think, feel, act, and relate to others.

2.title: Better Brain = Better Life
2.description: When your brain works right, you work right. You can make it better.

3.title: Help vs. Harm
3.description: Many things hurt the brain, many things help it. Small daily habits compound into significant differences.

4.title: Knowledge is Power
4.description: Understanding your brain helps you fix problems. Psychoeducation reduces shame.

5.title: Personalization
5.description: Different brain types need different treatments. One-size-fits-all approaches fail.

6.title: Brain Reserve
6.description: The brain can build capacity to handle challenges through consistent practice.

games.title: The 6 Brain Games
games.intro: Each game is designed to target specific brain regions and psychological mechanisms:

journey.intro: Like clay in the Potter's hands (Jeremiah 18:4), you are being reshaped over 40 days. The games unlock progressively, following a structure designed to build brain health systematically:

architecture.title: Why This Architecture Works
architecture.systemsBox: Systems Integration Principle: Brain systems work together in harmony. Imbalance in one system affects all others.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our B2B plans

q1.question: What data can our organization see about members?
q1.answer: Privacy is paramount. Your organization dashboard shows aggregate metrics only: total active users, average progress day, phase completion rates, and general engagement. You will never see individual journal entries, personal notes, or specific emotional data.

q2.question: Can we customize the app with our branding?
q2.answer: Our Ministry Plus and Enterprise tiers include white-label options. You can add your organization's logo to the welcome screen, customize the primary color scheme, and add a personalized welcome message for your members.

q3.question: How do access codes work?
q3.answer: When you purchase a plan, you receive unique access codes to distribute to your members. Each member downloads the Tea With God app and enters their code to unlock their access level. Codes can only be used once and are linked to the member's device.

q4.question: What happens if we need more codes?
q4.answer: You can purchase additional codes at any time at the same per-user rate. Enterprise customers can also upgrade to unlimited codes. Contact us to add more codes to your existing plan.

q5.question: Why is pricing different in different countries?
q5.answer: We believe devotional tools should be accessible regardless of economic circumstances. Our pricing is adjusted based on local purchasing power, not direct currency conversion. This means organizations in different countries pay what's affordable locally, not a US-dollar equivalent that might be out of reach.
